cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse_policy
from compiler.compiler import compile_policy
names = ['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
order = names; idx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(order)}
def make(nwords, plen=4, slen=4):
    prefixes = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=plen))[:nwords]
    suffixes = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=slen))[:nwords]
    words = [tuple(list(p)+list(s)) for p,s in zip(prefixes, suffixes)]
    return words
for nw in (3000, 8192):
    words = make(nw)
    pol = 'startswith() allow;' + ''.join('match(%s) drop;' % ','.join(names[c] for c in w) for w in words)
    print('nwords', nw, 'bytes', len(pol), 'atoms', len(words)+1, 'pathsyms', sum(len(w) for w in words))
    t=time.time(); rules,a,p = parse_policy(pol); tp=time.time()-t
    t=time.time()
    try:
        acc, rows, cells = compile_policy(rules, order, idx)
        print('  parse', round(tp,3), 'compile', round(time.time()-t,3), 'rows', len(rows), 'cells', cells)
    except Exception as e:
        print('  parse', round(tp,3), 'compile', round(time.time()-t,3), 'EXC', e)
PYEOF
